packageRules.description: Override security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm (pulled in via config:best-practices), which sets 3 days for the npm datasource and would otherwise shadow our top-level 7 days.
Renovate can't validate release age for these update types (they carry no releaseTimestamp, so the stability check would stay pending forever).
Exclude pre-1.0.0 versions from auto-merge (0.x minor bumps can be breaking by semver convention). Must come last so it overrides the rule above.
